name: Rail
description: Compose the primary application navigation rail from accessible items, separators and flexible spacers.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

slots.name: Item
slots.signature: ({ icon, label, shortcut, active, render, badge, disabledReason, className, onClick, ...rest }: RailItemProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: active
props.description: This is the current section.

props.name: badge
props.description: A NotificationDot or count on the icon's corner.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description:
Why the item does nothing here ("Choose an organisation to see its settings"). It stays
focusable (aria-disabled) and the tooltip and description give the reason (R12.3, R20.5).

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon element without an explicit size; the component sizes it through its tokens.

props.name: label
props.description: The destination's name: the accessible name and the tooltip.

props.name: render
props.description: Render as a router link: render={<Link to="/endpoints" />}.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: "g e" (press G, then E). Shown in the tooltip and handled by the rail.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

slots.name: Shortcut
slots.signature: ({ keys, onTrigger }: { keys: string; onTrigger: () => void; }): null

props.name: keys
props.description: The two-key sequence, space-separated and case-insensitive ("g m": press G, then M).

props.name: onTrigger
props.description: Called when the person types the sequence outside a text field, without Ctrl, Alt or Meta held.
